title: 병원에서 쓰는 말: 어디가 어떻게 아파요?
objective: By the end, you can tell a doctor or pharmacist how you feel (dizzy, itchy, swollen, indigestion) and understand and use words about treatment and recovery in short sentences.
summary: Learn ten intermediate words for describing symptoms, getting treatment, and recovering, as used at a clinic, a pharmacy, or with friends.

task.title: Use the health words
task.line: Choose, fill in, correct, or write the word or form that fits each situation.

words.exampleMeaning: Do you have any other symptoms besides the cough?
I feel dizzy when I stand up suddenly.

words.meaning: to have indigestion (food feels stuck after eating)
words.example: 점심을 급하게 먹어서 체한 것 같아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I think I have indigestion because I ate lunch too fast.

words.meaning: to swell, to get puffy (붓다 → 부어요, 부었어요)
words.exampleMeaning: When I woke up this morning, my face was really puffy.
The mosquito bite is really itchy.

words.meaning: a doctor's examination (진찰을 받다: to see a doctor)
words.example: 의사 선생님께 진찰을 받았는데 그냥 감기래요.
words.exampleMeaning: The doctor examined me and said it's just a cold.

words.meaning: a doctor's prescription (the paper you take to a pharmacy)
words.exampleMeaning: Take this prescription to a pharmacy.

words.meaning: to get a shot, to get an injection
words.example: 열이 많이 나서 병원에서 주사를 맞았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I had a high fever, so I got a shot at the clinic.

words.meaning: to recover, to get your health back
words.exampleMeaning: I hope you recover quickly after your surgery.

words.meaning: to overdo it, to push yourself too hard
words.example: 감기가 다 나을 때까지 무리하지 마세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Don't push yourself until your cold is completely gone.

exercises: Choose the word that fits: ① 팔에 뭐가 났는데 자꾸 ____. (가려워요 / 어지러워요) ② 배가 고파서 빵을 너무 빨리 먹었더니 ____. (체했어요 / 부었어요) ③ 하루 종일 서서 일해서 다리가 ____. (부었어요 / 가려워요)
Fill in each blank with 증상, 진찰, or 처방전: ① 의사: 어떤 ____이 있으세요? ② 약사: ____ 가져오셨어요? ③ ____ 결과, 큰 문제는 없대요.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 회복하다 or 무리하다: ① 할머니께서 수술 후에 잘 ____고 계세요. ② 어제 운동을 너무 ____서 오늘 온몸이 아파요.
Correct the mistake shown in parentheses: ① 열이 많이 나서 병원에서 주사를 받았어요. (주사를 받았어요) ② 어젯밤에 라면을 먹고 자서 눈이 부웠어요. (부웠어요)
Answer in Korean with one sentence: Your coworker says, "요즘 일어날 때마다 머리가 어지러워요." Give advice using 진찰 or 무리하다.
answers: ① 가려워요 ② 체했어요 ③ 부었어요
① 증상 ② 처방전 ③ 진찰
병원에 가서 진찰을 받아 보세요. (Other answers are possible, e.g., 너무 무리하지 마세요.)
